means: For every scored T-spin in the corpus (a T with an engine spin credit that cleared lines, inside the verified prefix, passing the reconstruction check), whether one of the 基本的なドネイト (basic donating) page's six hole windows stood around it: the lock's cells are the page's T (laid flat, pointing down, at a full TSD, as drawn or mirrored), and in a column 1 to 6 columns from the T's near arm the two cells in the rows the TSD clears are filled, the cell above them and the cell under them empty — a piece laid over a hole, donated to the TSD. Every hit is followed to the first later piece that enters the hole's column, to see whether it is the Tetris harddrop's Donation page draws next.
not_eligible_because: simulator output: which local shape a T went into is read off the vendored Triangle engine's boards, and nothing on the corpus side has a second implementation of it. No claim id, no badge, no figure in a report.
caveat: garbage is read as FILLED inside the window, and its hole columns are the engine's seeded-RNG columns, which disagree with the recorded ones (oracle-source.ts): a hole under a donation can be a garbage row's hole, so a hit's hole is the board the oracle offered, and a hit with garbage in its window is named in garbage_in_window for that reason. At a full TSD the two cleared rows are entailed by the clear (NaiveClauseForced): what discriminates is the empty cell above the donation and the empty hole under it. The windows read nothing else, so most named donations are hits too; the qualify rules give such a T to the page that names it (other_page). The payoff is harddrop's next step, not shiwehi.com's. Counts only, always N / M with the denominator.
rules: opportunity: a full TSD (2 lines) at a 0-based lock index <= the verified index, whose board-before plus its cells makes exactly the rows the engine recorded clearing (the reconstruction check, counted exactly as opener-facts.json donation.check counts it)

match, per variant k1..k6: the lock's cells equal the page's T under one translation (mirrored: columns reflected in the window), and every other window cell is filled (a piece or garbage) or empty as the page draws it; colour is never compared; cells outside the window are not read; each variant is matched on its own, so a T over two holes is a hit of two variants
mirrored is tried only when as-drawn fails; a window leaving the board is no match (window_off_board)

payoff: the hole's cell under the donation carried through every clear and garbage insertion, each step verified against the engine's next board, to the first later lock with a cell in its column; fired iff that lock is inside the verified prefix, has a cell at or below the carried cell, is an I and cleared 4 lines (otherwise past_verified, well_covered, well_filled_not_i, i_in_well_not_quad, rowmap_unverified, slot_off_board or round_ended); well_depth = the empty cells under the well cell on the board before the spin, garbage filled
controls: the same windows at the profile's other scored spins; ablations no_must_empty, no_roof and t_overlap at the opportunity; orientation_baseline = opportunities whose T stands up
window_rule: 0-based lock index <= 21 is in_opener (emit-opener-facts.ts's convention; emit-attack-facts.ts counts from 1)

rules: fragment: a donated cell (the hole's column in the two rows the TSD clears, mirrored with the window) belongs to a piece not all four of whose cells are on the board before the T (a line clear cut it)
garbage_in_shape: a donated cell is garbage
shape_cell_empty: a donated cell is empty (the window requires it filled, so only a weakened window can admit this)
dpc: the board is empty after one of the 14 locks before the T, the T itself, or one of the 14 after it (the DPC setup)
ownership_unverified: a lock before the T has a row map the digest could not verify, so its pieces cannot be told apart

other_page: another technique page's window (stsd, stmbcave, imperialcross, doubledagger, btcannon, cutcopy, shachikutrain, parapet, kaidan, dtcannon; any variant, either hand) fires at the same T, so the T is that page's
nearer_well: a variant with a smaller hole offset fires at the same T, so the T is counted once, at its nearest hole
well_covered: a filled cell anywhere above the window in the hole's column, so the clear does not leave the hole open from the top
shallow_well: the nub variant only: fewer than 4 empty cells under the nub, so the re-opened column cannot take a Tetris
qualifies iff none applies; the shape stood at every hit either way
